name: ice...ice
source:
Cynthia finds herself in an icy wasteland.

Will she find the treasure she's looking for? Will the inhabitants be any help?

[From [url=https://leafletgames.itch.io/iceice]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Cynthia发现自己身处一片冰封荒原。

她能找到正在寻找的宝藏吗？这里的居民会帮上忙吗？

[摘自[url=https://leafletgames.itch.io/iceice]Itch.io[/url]]
